title: Individual etale derived chart models and their stalk and comparison realizations
statement: Let X be any scheme and B a Noetherian commutative ring in the independent coefficient universe. Let K be a bounded complex over the constant B-ring on the coefficient-sized etale site, with finite locally constant cohomology. For every point i of X one can choose an etale object W_i whose image contains i and an algebraic derived B-module M_i. For every point x in the image of W_i, M_i is isomorphic to the specified derived stalk of K at X.algClosurePoint(x). For every coefficient-sized pro-etale object V with a morphism to W_i viewed as a pro-etale object, the actual-slice restriction to V of the derived constant realization of M_i is isomorphic to the restriction of adicFinitePullback(K). Stalk, comparison, restrictions and constant realization are [def-sfb-coefficient-etale-derived-stalk], [def-sfb-adic-residue-lift-comparisons], and [def-sfb-site-derived-constant-module-functor]. No identification of the models of different charts is asserted.

source.place: lemma-locally-constant (Tag 094G); etale-cohomology.tex proof of lemma-connected-ctf-locally-constant (09BI), individual chart construction and stalk identification before connectedness; comparison Tag 099R.

proof.text: Use the proved exact scalar equivalence and the fixed-scalar finite-local-constancy lemma. Transport cohomology bounds using exact-functor cohomology comparison. Replace lower bound c by min(c,d), and apply exists_site_bounded_constant_model to the topology precoverage. Transfer its covering family through AsSmall.down and choose one chart above each point; all choices remain within this existential proof.

For every point in the chosen chart image, lift its algebraic-closure geometric point to that chart. Apply the supplied-chart derived stalk theorem to get the required isomorphism with Q of its ordinary cochain model.

Apply the supplied-chart comparison theorem to every pro-etale object factoring through the selected chart. It gives precisely the displayed actual-slice isomorphism for the commutative constant realization and adicFinitePullback.

theorem coefficient_etale_derived_chart_atlas
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (B : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    (K : ConstantCompletion.D
      (ConstantCompletion.constant (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) B))
    (hbounded : ∃ c d : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < c ∨ d < q →
      IsZero ((coefficientModelCohomology _ q).obj K))
    (hlisse : ∀ q : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsLocallyConstantFiniteTypeModules
      (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) B
      ((coefficientModelCohomology _ q).obj K)) :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ConstantCompletion.Mod
      (ConstantCompletion.constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) B))
    ∃ (W : X → X.Etale) (M : X → DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} B)),
      (∀ x : X, x ∈ Set.range (W x).hom.base) ∧
      (∀ (i x : X), x ∈ Set.range (W i).hom.base →
        Nonempty (M i ≅ (coefficientEtaleDerivedStalk X B (X.algClosurePoint x)).obj K)) ∧
      ∀ (i : X) (V : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X),
        ((AsSmall.down : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X ⥤ X.ProEt).obj V ⟶
          (toProEt X).obj (W i)) →
        Nonempty ((adicResidueRestriction
          (ConstantCompletion.constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) B) V).obj
            ((commutativeSiteDerivedConstantModuleFunctor.{max v (u + 1), max v (u + 1),
              max v (u + 1), max v (u + 1) + 1}
              (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) B).obj (M i)) ≅
          (adicResidueRestriction
            (ConstantCompletion.constant (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) B) V).obj
              ((adicFinitePullback.{u, v} X B).obj K))
